reason_for_new_stage: User steering explicitly requires a little post-training and sensitivity-aware treatment; the earlier affine-butterfly rejection rule is therefore interpreted as terminating the no-post-training PTQ hypothesis only, not this separately preregistered trained representation
objective: Test whether complete-block teacher distillation of only deployable affine-base3 degrees of freedom can recover Qwen3.8-27B quality without changing the 1.6674-bpw representation

scope.coverage: Every rank-2-or-higher weight in each selected complete block; all PTQ sites remain quantized during distillation and no sensitive site may silently fall back to BF16
scope.claim_boundary: A trained three-complete-block representation gate, not a whole-model artifact, capability result, CPU runtime result, or breakthrough

data.parent: The authenticated exact BF16 block cache created by qwen38_27b_affine_butterfly_block_cache_receipt_v1
data.separation: The same frozen disjoint calibration and validation texts are reused; validation rows never select sites, steps, learning rates, checkpoints, or exceptions
data.evaluation_contamination_forbidden: CUTE, MATH-500, sealed code, WikiText, and MMLU items remain excluded from both splits

sensitivity_protocol.measurement: For each site independently, replay the complete block with only that site decoded from the packed PTQ representation and all other rank-2-or-higher weights exact; report calibration and held-out validation complete-block NMSE plus the all-sites interaction result
sensitivity_protocol.selection_rule: Calibration single-site NMSE ranks sensitivity for reporting only; all sites receive the frozen training stage, and validation sensitivity cannot alter training
sensitivity_protocol.mixed_mode_boundary: No higher-precision exception is authorized by this preregistration. Any later mixed-mode design must be separately frozen from calibration-only sensitivity and must count every exception in complete-model bpw

trained_representation.unchanged_storage: Canonical 203-bit-per-128-trit base-3 codes; packed 4-bit alpha and mu indices; one FP16 alpha row anchor and one FP16 mu row anchor per output row; one 16-entry FP16 alpha codebook and one 16-entry FP16 signed-mu codebook per tensor; six FP16 Givens stages per activation site
trained_representation.runtime_equation: Apply each stored shared Givens transform once, then accumulate alpha times ternary dot plus mu times activation group sum without materializing dense weights
trained_representation.trainable_continuous_state: Decoded alpha and mu row anchors, their per-tensor 16-entry codebooks, and stored Givens angles, all optimized through hard-forward straight-through copies and frozen back to their declared FP16 storage after every optimizer step
trained_representation.trainable_discrete_state: Ternary assignments and 4-bit alpha/mu indices receive one deterministic projected coordinate update after each continuous optimizer step using calibration block-output gradients; the hard packed state is the next forward state
trained_representation.forbidden_state: No LoRA, dense residual, latent shadow weight, optimizer state, calibration cache, or teacher tensor is retained in the deployable artifact

training.loss: Sum squared trained-candidate-minus-parent complete-block output divided by parent complete-block output energy over all 64 calibration rows
training.optimizer: Adam over continuous deployable parameters only
training.checkpoint_selection: The eighth and final hard-packed state is scored; no best-of-step or validation checkpoint selection
training.resource_rule: Train one complete block at a time with restart only at a fully packed and authenticated block checkpoint; retain at most the current and immediately previous block payload
training.no_sweep: One optimizer, one learning rate, one step count, one projection frequency, one layer set, and one data split are frozen

falsification_gate.metric: Held-out complete-block output NMSE on the 32 validation rows
falsification_gate.pass_action: Run one restartable 64-layer trained conversion and then whole-model CUTE, MATH-500, sealed code, WikiText, MMLU-type, and paired CPU runtime gates
falsification_gate.reject_action: Use the frozen calibration sensitivity report to preregister at most one honestly budgeted mixed-mode representation; do not tune this QAT protocol on validation

whole_model_budget.accounting: All codes, anchors, indices, codebooks, rotations, exact tensors, mixed-mode exceptions, descriptors, alignment, metadata, and auxiliary model files count

stop_conditions: Any selected block fails to beat direct ternary by 30 percent on held-out validation after the frozen final step
Any selected block regresses relative to its packed PTQ parent
Any site or rank-2-or-higher tensor is omitted
Any validation value influences training, site allocation, checkpoint choice, or a mixed-mode exception
Any packed state, FP16 state, source, cache, denominator, or repository identity is unauthenticated
Projected complete-model storage exceeds 1.70 bits per total text parameter
Infrastructure-invalid execution is recorded and retried without being scored as a scientific rejection
